examples.english: but they were upright before Him that is upright, that is to say, God; and for this reason He made them chiefs over their enemies.

examples.english: For we know, O my beloved, that all those who are filled with envy, and ill-will, and unbelief, are the enemies of righteousness; take good heed to yourselves, therefore, that ye may not become the enemies of righteousness.
